name: stage4_pilot
registered: 2026-09-26, before any pilot training run (only a 2-epoch / 300-slice smoke test, see md)
status: PILOT of a new method; motivated by the exploratory analysis NOTES_stage4_analysis.md
method_summary: SAMOS-style climatological standardisation fitted on training stations only (ridge regression of climatological mean and log-variance of obs and of the t2m ensemble mean on [1,lat,lon,alt,alt-orog] x [1,sin/cos 1st and 2nd annual harmonic] (+ lead one-hot x [1,sin1,cos1] for EUPPBench)); network models the standardised anomaly with an ensemble-anchored residual mean mu = m_y + s_y*(z_f + g) and constrained spread sigma = s_y*sqrt(softplus(c)^2+softplus(d)^2 z_s^2); single-head attention over the K=8 nearest available TRAINING stations (self excluded) + learned null slot; neighbour token = [z_f_j, z_s_j, z_f_j - z_f_i, distance/100km, altitude difference/500m, (alt-orog) difference/500m, learned 4-d embedding of station j]; own input = all z-scored ensemble statistics + z_f + z_s + 4 standardised attributes + time features (as drn_lak); trained with random station masking: per batch a fraction U(0,0.5) of training stations removed from the neighbour pool, and per sample with probability 0.5 all training stations within r~U(0,300) km of the target removed. The target's own embedding is never used, so every prediction is made as for a new station. Val/test: no masking. Implementation: src/ppnn_residual/stage4_pilot.py

samos_mlp.role: ablation: same standardisation and output, no neighbours/attention/masking

no_tuning: all hyperparameters fixed a priori as listed; no selection on any test-period score
phase_1: German data, random + spatial folds, samos_attn and samos_mlp, seeds 0-2
phase_2_condition: EUPPBench (same design) is run only if phase 1 is 'promising': the German spatial-fold CRPS of samos_attn is lower than that of the best primary comparator (point estimate)

comparators.seed_rule: networks compared as seeds 0-2 ensembles (mean of mu and sigma) on both fold types

tests: DM on daily (per-initialisation) mean CRPS differences, Newey-West lag 5, two-sided; 7-day moving-block bootstrap, 10000 reps, 95% CI; BH q=0.05 over the family {samos_attn vs each primary comparator} x {random, spatial} (6 tests) per dataset

go_no_go.GO: on the German data, samos_attn vs the best primary comparator on SPATIAL folds (lowest CRPS among the three) is BH-significant AND the bootstrap CI excludes 0 AND samos_attn is better, AND on RANDOM folds samos_attn has the same sign (lower CRPS) vs the best primary comparator on random folds
go_no_go.reporting: GO/NO-GO is reported whatever the outcome; strict_secondary comparisons, samos_attn vs samos_mlp, per-fold, distance-bin and out-of-range-station diagnostics are reported descriptively
go_no_go.phase_2_reporting: if run, EUPPBench is evaluated with the same rule (replication check), and reported whatever the outcome

compute: local 8-core CPU, <=2 processes x 4 threads, resumable
